title: Stone Vanities & Bathroom Stone
activity: Stone vanity tops, cladding and floors
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Flood test of the waterproofing (shower, under bath, under vanities) done before stone – water level unchanged at the end?
questions.source: EDM stone ITP ESC-00015 items 13, 21 – hold point

questions.q: Stone matches the benchmark for colour and veining?
Uncoupling membrane laid under the stone, no gaps?
Ask the fitter: Which grout and sealant colour is approved here, and how do you repair a chip? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Stone fixed with at least 75% adhesive coverage on the back?

guide.title: Stone – EPR 74 figures
rows: 2 mm max under a 2 m straightedge

questions.q: Vanity top and bath level and supported; sink and waste aligned?
Grout joints clean, full and even; silicone neat at junctions?
Bath access panel fitted and removable?

notOk.t: Grout inconsistent, discoloured or missing; excess grout left
Chips repaired with grout infill (resin repair only – BM-26)
Gaps between portal and wall / uneven pencil-line gap
Stone thickness out of range / lippage
Sharp edges, stained or marked stone
Perimeter joint varying (1–2 mm up to 20 mm recorded)

ask.q: What adhesive coverage on the back?

ask.a: Within 2 mm; joints max 2 mm (control joints 4 mm) – EPR 74.
As the EPR finish – sealed before grouting/silicone.
